# A faceted grey stone for the banks' edges. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 1 --location 0 0 0.12
scale 0.42 0.32 0.26
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 3
mode object
material new Stone --base-color 0.580 0.690 0.761
material assign Stone
shade flat
export rock.glb
